notes:
• ? → Activity shows who changed what in the library, and when. A deleted set list can be put back from there.
• ? → Your name… shows the name your changes are saved under, and lets you change it.
• When the library won't connect, the app now says why — for example, when this device's clock is wrong.
• Tap along in the chart tool is more accurate: the playhead now shows exactly what you're hearing, so eighth-note taps land where you meant them.
• While you tap along, the timeline keeps the playhead in view.
• A chord copied with its length or mark now pastes back as a chord.
• Dragging a section marker onto another one replaces it.
• The User Guide now covers key, tempo and time changes inside a chart, and why Bluetooth headphones make tap along land late.
